rule: One unfinished topic for the whole team. Reservation persists between rounds, during timeout/retry, after the starter leaves, and across host handoff. Completing every round releases the reservation.
implementation: Derived from existing authoritative, checkpointed station progress. No duplicate progress owner or additional network protocol.
ui: Blocked Books name the unfinished topic and disable Start. The same active topic remains available for team cooperation.
limits: Unity Editor plus two independent headless Photon clients; remote rendered UI and physical Android not verified.
